# The Membrane

> Self-hosted authorization for SI agents. Caller-bound signed scopes, operator-owned grants and revocation, and tamper-evident receipts for requests routed through the gate.

This is the Rust project at github.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane, not other products named Membrane. Code: AGPL-3.0-only; repository documentation: CC BY 4.0. Early-stage software with no supported stable release or production-assurance guarantee. The hosted demo has recorded and simulated data, not a live gate. Receipts attest authorized request intent, not upstream completion.

## Evaluate

- [Evaluation guide](https://themembrane.org/agent-guide.md): Local allow/deny check, prerequisites, limits and integration decisions.
- [Repository README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/README.md): Current source build, workspace and documentation map.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/quickstart.md): Separate operator and caller keys, signed request and replay refusal.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/SECURITY.md): Early-stage status, reporting route and deployment limits.

## Integrate

- [Caller identity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/caller-identity.md): Signed scopes, fresh caller proofs, grant windows and revocation limits.
- [Policy as code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/policy-as-code.md): Validate, review, apply and accepted-generation migration.
- [Operator walkthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/operator-walkthrough.md): Local relay, receipts and evidence export.
- [GitHub connector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/github-connector.md): Supported upstream connector, credentials, write operation IDs and reconciliation.
- [Pilot guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/pilot.md): Workflow scope, prerequisites, evaluation and contact.

## Limits

- [Gate threat model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/threat-model-gate.md): Trust boundaries, required-path assumptions and deployment responsibilities.

- [Enforcement limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/audit-fixes.md): Baseline limits; read together with the durable-journal follow-up.
- [Durable journal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/durable-journal.md): Recovery, intent records, storage assumptions and upstream reconciliation.
- [Demo behavior](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/membrane-hq/the-membrane/main/docs/demo.md): Recorded hosted replay, simulated tool effects and the separate local demo.
